name: produce a SLURM cluster-monitoring log (node counts; exact header/format)
definition: Query SLURM for node counts and emit one correctly formatted monitoring log.
failure_mode: Repeated headers, wrong timestamp format, or wrong fractional precision fail format checks.

name: query a live blockchain node/RPC for status, block, transaction, and account data
